reels.caption:
Welcome to $34 million of pure Florida luxury. This residence pushes the boundaries of design with a post-tension build that eliminates all columns, creating a seamless flow from the minimalist kitchen to the expansive waterfront lounge.

Every element is bespoke, including the floating staircase and a glass lift that anchors the open-plan entertainment space.

Beyond the living areas, the home trades traditional decor for high-octane inspiration, featuring a hypercar-themed office and a garage that functions as a private museum.

Housing icons like the McLaren Senna and an electric Rolls-Royce, this is more than a home, it's a gallery for the elite collector. Unreal design meets unmatched performance.

For more information, reach out directly to @howardpanes.

The full tour is available on The Luxury Home Show YouTube channel.
